title: From the scorching flames
description: This mezmur reflects God’s deliverance from trials and dangers, especially through the intercession of the Archangel Gabriel. It draws from the biblical story of the fiery furnace and emphasizes divine protection even in the midst of suffering. The chant highlights faith that remains unshaken despite trials, the power of angels as servants of God, and victory over persecution. It also connects to saints who endured suffering and were saved by God’s grace.

Chorus
Who is the righteous one of Ethiopia’s land?
I asked, with a longing to touch where you would stand.
I sought out your blessing, with my heart opened wide,
I came to your door and tasted your love inside.

seed in Ityisa, in faith you were grown,
You left all the world for the Lord alone.
Debre Libanos stands living and strong,
Proclaiming your glory in prayer in song.
Tekle Haymanot, beloved 
My home and my abode are blessed

Verse:
Lord who exalts you has crowned you with grace,
now you are near us, unseen in this place.
In humility we stand, at your gate
prayers of the righteous are grand great
Tekle Haymanot, a bright sun 
Let grace pour upon me from heaven

Verse:
led us to pastures so living and green,
fed us the Word, pure and gentle and clean.
The Gospel’s bright torch your hands set aflame
Enlightend all ages in the lords name.
Tekle Haymanot, beloved
My home and my abode are blessed

Verse:
bore thirty, sixty, a hundred once more,
Stood at debre asbo, one foot on the floor.
Bartholomew’s hope fulfilled in your way,
The Lord’s holy path was straightened that day.
Tekle Haymanot, beloved 
My home and my abode are blessed

It emphasizes trust in her intercession and gratitude for her constant presence and care throughout life.

It emphasizes the importance of living a righteous life and seeking God’s grace before that day arrives.

ዘንድሮ \"መስቀል\" ነው የቢላ ሞረድ።

ደሙም ዘር አልሆነ እያደር ማነስ።

የጴጥሮስ ፣ የጳውሎስ ታሪክ ባ’ይኔ ‘ማይ፥
ጦቢያ የመሰለኝ ሮም አይደለም ወይ?

ኧረ መ'ላ በ'ሉት ተው/ዉ በ'ሉት በ'ሉት! (ጠብቆና ላልቶ ይደገማል)

አቅም የሚሰጠው ብርቱካ’ን እያለ፥
መብላቱ መች ጠፍቶት እየከፋፈለ።
ምን ያገብረኛል መቆም ለወረት፥
ለየትኛው ሰዓታት እያለ መቅረት።

በገሃድ እንዳንጦም ከዝግን ፣ ቅቅሉ፥
እስኪ ጠይቁልን መቼ ዋለ ባ’ሉ?
እግዚአብሔር ልዑል በመንበሩ ሳለ፥
ሰው በሰው ላይ ወጥቶ “ከፋ’ለ ከፋ’ለ”።

ተጻፈ በከሣቴ ብርሃን በዕለተ ልደት ፣ ዘ፳፻፲፰  ዓ.ም።

Description:
“Egnan Kewededebet” is a powerful Ethiopian Orthodox mezmur performed by Zemarit Firewoyin Berihun. The original mezmur was written and owned by the gifted Zemari Gebre Yohannes Gebre Tsadik.

This mezmur speaks of the ultimate love of God, who sacrificed Himself unto death for our salvation. It is a touching reminder of His mercy, compassion, and the price He paid to redeem us. A song of deep worship and reflection, it invites all believers to remember the love that held Christ to the cross.

description:
እመኑ በእርሱ ድንቅ ያደርጋል ጌታ
Emenu Bersu dnk yadergal geta 
በረድ አዝንቦ  ጠላት እየመታ
Bered azinbo telat eyemeta
ውቅያኖስ ጥልቁን ፈጥኖ ያተነነ
Wkyanos tlku fetno yatenene 
ነገር ለወጠ ሁሉ በእርሱ ሆነ 
Neger lewete hulu bersu hone

Believe in the Lord, He works wonders and feats 
Sending hail down and striking his enemies 
By his might the depths, and the seas became haze
He changed the outcome, by Him all things were made  

Believe in the Lord, The mountain is ablaze 
Believe in the Lord, The valley disarranged
Believe in the Lord, The evergreen is crushed 
Believe in the Lord, and the rock ground to dust 
Believe in the Lord, the gentiles’ statues  
Believe in the Lord, before Him were no more 
Believe in the Lord, Those who invoked His name 
Believe in the Lord, sailed calmly through the storms 

Believe in the Lord, the sun will always rise
Believe in the Lord, every day becomes night
Believe in the Lord, He can perform all things
Believe in the Lord, our Savior, our Might
Believe in the Lord, to us He is Lord Love
Believe in the Lord, Father of creation
Believe in the Lord, He looks down from above
Believe in the Lord, His hands are stretched to us

Believe in the Lord, we have a sturdy boat
Believe in the Lord, no storm or waves can break
Believe in the Lord, so we won’t fear henceforth
Believe in the Lord, our lives He won’t forsake
Believe in the Lord, The enemy has lost 
Believe in the Lord, Satan is put to shame 
Believe in the Lord, let the prisons rejoice
Believe in the Lord, with joyful hymns of praise

Believe in the Lord, The crafty lies of foes
Believe in the Lord, are empty, have no might
Believe in the Lord, Emmanuel Logos
Believe in the Lord, is with us through our plight  
Believe in the Lord, when our Lord bestows 
Believe in the Lord, His grace which is plenty
Believe in the Lord, we will stand atop death
Believe in the Lord, singing hymns joyfully

   \"        \"          በዱር በበረሃ

   \"        \"          ከዓለቱ ውሃ
የፊቴ ፈገግታ የውስጤ ፍስሐ
ከአምላክ የተሠጠኝ በረከት አምሐ።

#ሚካኤል ነው  ያሳደገኝ መልአክ

title: In That Very Hour
description: This mezmur reflects the Second Coming of Jesus Christ and the final judgment. It describes the gathering of all people, the separation of the righteous and the sinners, and the overwhelming reality of God’s judgment. The chant serves as a warning and a call to repentance, encouraging believers to remain faithful and prepared for the day when all will stand before Christ.

It emphasizes devotion, humility, and trust in her motherly care.

title_english: For There’s No One Like Him
description: This mezmur proclaims the unmatched power and greatness of God, declaring that there is no one like Him. It reflects on His mighty works throughout history, such as parting the Red Sea and bringing down Jericho, showing His authority over all creation and enemies. The chant calls believers to stand firm in faith, rejoice, and praise God for His victories, protection, and miracles. It emphasizes divine power, faith, and joyful worship.

title: Yihew Izemralehu Leimebete
title_english: I will forever sing for my Lady
description:
Original song: Yihew Ezemiralew Le Emebete
Singer: Liqe Lisanat Cherenet Senay

I will forever sing for my Lady 
For she has filled my home with homily
Because she’s visited me through this wretched life
I will praise the Virgin until the end of time 

From my sorrowful face she soothed away my tears 
I’m made to magnify her with songs and prayers 
With misery and pain I no longer suffer 
Into my home she came the mother of wonder

The disarray of life crumbling around me 
She cleared it all away restored my sanity 
She listens to my pleas my appeals and my cries
With her intercession my prayers will arise 

No longer do I see through a clouded vision 
My eyes have been healed by her hands of compassion 
When I appeal to her with sorrow and despair 
Immaculate is she, to the world I’ll declare 

Day and night I lament with a heavy burden 
From drowning she saved me so I won’t be saddened 
For she has pulled me free from the clench of my sins 
To her eternally I will raise up my hands

title: Truly with Glory
description: This mezmur proclaims the resurrection of Jesus Christ with joy and certainty, declaring His victory over death and corruption. It emphasizes that through His death, He destroyed death and became the first fruit of the resurrection. The chant highlights the futility of human attempts to contain Him, affirming His divine power and eternal nature. It calls believers to rejoice in His triumph, recognizing His sacrifice, boundless love, and the salvation granted through His resurrection.

   ንፁሁ በግ ተገኝተሃል 
   ያለ ስስት ሳመልክህ 
   እኖራለሁ በቤትህ

     በደለኛ አመጸኛ

     አስታጠቅከኝ የፅድቅን ጦር

አክሊለ ሾህ ደፍተህ በሽቶች መሃል 
ተሰቅለህ ያየሁህ በእንጨት መስቀል
በልቤ መቅረዝ ላይ ለዘላለም አብራ
ሰው ሆኛለሁና በማዳንህ ስራ
       ቅኔ ዜማ መተንፈሴ

title: Nikodimos English Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Hymn
title_english: Nikodimos English Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Hymn
description:
Original Singer : Zemari Dn Kidametsega Yohannes
Original Song : Nikodimos 
Mezmur translator :  Zemarit Gellila Yohannes 
 
Nikodimos nikodemos kibur
Lelitun bebirehan yemimar memehir 
Nikodimos Nikodimos the honored
From dusk until dawn, A teacher who learns 

Despite the darkened sky, one star shined in the night
Neglecting worldly things, steadfast amid the plight
Though he was a teacher, he never ceased to learn
The tethers of his pride, with humbleness, he did tear and did spurn

A love that conquers fear, did reign within his heart
He buried his Teacher, through this he did his part
the Shroud of our Lord, he honored with perfume
In doing so he was given life with Christ the heavenly groom

Passing from Lord to lord, true Wisdom was revealed 
To those who keep the Law, I will advise indeed 
If your soul awakens, and returns from her sins 
Just like Nikodimos, your soul, stands with the Lord therein

description: This mezmur is a humble prayer of repentance and dependence on God. It expresses a deep desire for guidance, forgiveness, and protection throughout life until the believer returns to Him. The chant highlights God as the source of healing, peace, and righteousness, while acknowledging human sinfulness and the need for His mercy. It calls upon God to guard the soul, lead it on the right path, and ultimately grant salvation through His grace and love.

title: Gabriel the powerful
description: This mezmur honors the Archangel Gabriel as a powerful protector and bearer of good news. It reflects on his role in delivering and protecting the faithful, especially in times of trial and persecution. The chant references biblical and traditional stories of endurance, including the protection of the righteous in fire and the faith of saints like Cyricus. It emphasizes intercession, courage, and trust in God’s help through His angels.

It reflects on the humility of His birth in a manger, the wonder of the angels, and the witness of the wise men. It calls believers to contemplate and glorify this profound mystery with reverence and faith.

description:
አንተ አለህ በክብር አንተ አለህ በከፍታ
አንተ አለህ በልዕልና ያህዌ የእኛ ጌታ
ያህዌ አምላካችን የሕይወታችን አንድምታ
ያህዌ ፈጣሪያችን የመኖራችን ዋልታ

ሳይታይ የየብስ ፊቱ
ቀላያት ሳይከፈቱ
ሰማይና ምድር ሳይኖሩ
ብርሃናት ሁሉ ሳይበሩ
ኮረብቶች ፊቱ ሳይቆሙ
አበቦች ሳይለመልሙ
    ሳይመዘዙ መባርቅት 
    ሳይንጓደዱ ብርሃናት
    ነጎድጓድ ድምፅ ሳይሰጡ
    ከዋክብት ሳይፈነጥቁ 
    ከፍ ብለህ ከፍታ 
    ብቻህን ነበርክ ጌታ

የወንዝ ጎርፎች ሳይፈሱ
ነፋሳት ገና ሳይነፍሱ
የውሃ ምንጮች ሳይፈሉ
ሁኑ ሳይላቸው በቃሉ
ደመናው ግዘፍ ሳይሳብ
ሳይበጅ የምድርም ክበብ
      መዓልቱ ገና ሳይኖር
      ሌሊትም ሳይፈጠር
      ጨለማው ሳይጋረድ
      ሳጥናኤል ሳይዋረድ 
      መላእክት ሳይፈጠሩ 
      ያህዌ ነበር በክብሩ

ከሁሉ የተሰወርክ 
በክብርህ ከክረህ የኖርክ
ማይደረስብህ ጥልቅ 
ማትመረመር ምጡቅ
ኮረብቶችን የመዘንክ
ውኆችንም የሰፈርክ 
ሁሉን የምትመረምር
ግሩም ነህ ማትደፈር
    በባሕሪይህ ከብረህ 
    በምስጋና ተከበህ
    የነበርክ በዘላለም
    ያህዌ እንዳንተ የለም

ሳትደክም ምትሸከም 
ሳታጎድል ምትሰጥ ሰላም 
ሳትተኛ  ምትጠብቅ 
ሳትነጥፍ ሁሉንታውቅ
በፍቅር ምትገዛ ንጉስ
ነቅ የሌለብህ ቅዱስ 
ሁሉን ምትፈውስ መድህን 
የጠበቅከን በዘመን
   ምታስብ ሳትዘነጋ
   ምትሰጥ ለሁሉ ዋጋ 
   ምትተው ሳትቀበል 
   አምላክ ነህ ጌታ ልዑል

የመመኪያችን ዘውድ
የተ ዛመድከን ዘመድ 
የደኅንነታችን ፋና
የመኖራችን ዋስትና
የሕይወታችን መሠረት፤ 
የቤታችን ጉልላት፤ 
የማንነታችን ውበት 
ለመኖራችን ድምቀት 
   አልጫውን ያጣፈጥክ 
   ጨለማውን ያሳደድክ 
   አለሙን ያበራህ ፋና
   ከፍ በል በምስጋና

description:
Original Song: Nu Temelketulign
Original Singer: Tesfaye Edo & Hiwot Berle


At the works of our Lord come all and then marvel 
The deeds of our God of our Emmanuel 
Sara and Abraham became their example

Hannah and Joachim were made strong through prayer 
Their works found true and fair in front of their maker 
Persistently walked in holy matrimony 
The mother of our Lord they birthed Virgin Mary 

Day and night he would pray the priest Zacharias
Pleaded Elizabeth through all her barriers 
With the talents of God even in their old state 
He gave them the honor of having John the Saint 

Holy Tsegazeab and Egziharya
Benevolently wed icons of their era
Through their seed they begot Saint Teklehaymnot 
Through the day and the night prayer they both devote

Nu temelketulign ye Amanualin sira

ሓዘነይ ንብዓተይ ክነግር ንኣደይ
ሎሚ ብበረኸት መሊኣቶ ቤትይ
ዝዓነወ ህይወተይ እቲ ዝፈረሰ
ብልመና ድንግል ኵሉ ተሓደሰ
ንብዓተይ ጸሎተይ ኣውያተይ ሰሚዓ
ድንግል ኣደ ጎይታ ንረዲኤት መጺኣ
ሸኸም ከቢዱኒ ክሓዝን ክቑዝም
ድንግል ምጺኣትኒ ደኺመ ከይተርፍ
ስለ ዘውጽኣትኒ ካብ መዓሙቅ ጉድጓድ
የእዳወይ ዘርጊሐ ንኽብራ ክዝምር

title: Within the Sinner's Tent
description: This mezmur expresses the profound mercy of Christ who seeks out and saves sinners. It reflects on God’s presence entering into the life of the unworthy, bringing comfort, healing, and transformation. The chant emphasizes personal redemption, comparing the believer to the lost coin found by the Lord. It highlights God’s compassion, His desire to dwell with His people, and the peace and strength He gives to overcome trials, calling believers to respond with gratitude and praise.

title: Yihin Laderege
title_english: For All That He Has Done
description:
Original Song: Yihin Laderege Haleluya Belu
Original Singer: Dagmawi Derbe

For all that he has done praise with hallelujah
Faithful is our Lord Eternal Messiah  
The groom and bride rejoice you are in His embrace
Jacob’s God is with you He has become your grace


The mountains we passed the cliffs and hills
We stood with His grace strength He instills 
Let us sing to Him with happiness
Dependable is the Lord our bliss 
We cannot succeed with our brute strength
We will praise the Lord who sealed our fate 
His abundant love shines bright we say 
The light of his lamp Leading the way

The omnipotent nurturing Lord 
Made all possible to his accord 
Like children of Zuph we stand in line
To exalt His name with songs and rhyme
All those who are blessed by His great palms
Will pour from their mouth the purest songs 
With the angels we have unified
In His graceful works we will abide 

Although the barrels appear empty 
He will care for us the Almighty 
The undesired will leave our place
We are safeguarded in His embrace
We are aided like Ebenezer
At our weakest point He gives power
Our faces will shine with thankfulness 
For He has become our joyfulness

አይመረመርም \"ቅድመ ዓለም ነጋሢ\"

ያንተን ሥራ. . . .

እሳትና ውኃ ነፋስና መሬት፥

\"የፍጥረቱም ገዢ ታደርገው ዘንድ ሰው..
ምንድር ነው?\" ያለ ዳዊት መቼ መረመረው?

ያንተን ሥራ. . .

ከፈጠረበትም ያዳነበት ጥበብ፥
የሚረቅ ነውና ሥጋዌው ሊታሰብ፥
እንደ ሕርያቆስ በነፋስ ትከሻ፥
ተጭነን መብረርን መመርመር አንሻ!
ወደ ቀድሞ ነገር በእምነት መመለሻ፥
ጸሎተ ሃይማኖት ነው መነሻ መድረሻ።

ያንተን ሥራ...

ስለዚያችም ሰዓት ፣ ዕለተ ምጽአት፥
ከአብ ብቻ በቀር በግብር ማን ሊያውቃት፥
ወልድ በቃልነቱ ትለፍ ሳይል ዓለሙን፥
ሥጋውን በልተነው ተቀብለን ደሙን፥
\"አይመረመሬው ሳይመራመረን\"
በደል ተደምስሶ መንግሥቱን ይቸረን!

ያንተን ሥራ....

description:
Original Song: Alfa Ena Omega
Singer: Liqe Mezemeran Kinetibeb Weldekirkos

Alpha and Omega by all you are worshipped 
In the hands of traitors you were brought for verdict 

They pushed and abused you they wanted to subdue 
While inflicting torment Christ they said mocking you

Adam’s children were saved as you carried our pain

With your bound outstretched hands you carried our sins
All the soldiers mocked you as you hanged on the tree
I must never forget the price you paid for me

title_english: Oh All That You Have Done For Me
description:
Oh all that you have done for me with humility
I will give praise and worship you with jubilee
Emanuel for eternity I will submit to you my heart fully /x2/

The day that became night drowned by the darkness
Suffering through the marsh that took me under it
When I had thought I lost the ones supporting me
He truly stowed away my troubles endlessly

Our Lord and our strength our glory and power
Humiliated them with faith my wrongdoers
That you won’t forsake me finally I know truth
Above worldly calling I’ve committed to you

Few became abundant You fed the multitudes
To show my gratitude enough I can’t give you
Through the days and the nights, the one that shines the light
Glorious it all is your works and all Your might

Deserving you are for praise and admiration
For the humble of heart blessings, you have given
Impoverished I am not you are my fortune
My life is filled by you never again barren

title: Qwanqwaye Nesh Dingil
description: This mezmur honors the Virgin Mary as the spiritual mediator through whom believers approach God. It expresses humility, acknowledging unworthiness before God, and gratitude for her intercession which allows prayers to be heard. The chant reflects transformation through her love, turning a sinful life into one of praise and holiness. It emphasizes that through honoring her, believers draw closer to God, and it celebrates the joy and peace that fill the soul when praising her, following the example of the saints.

title: Cher Agelgay Manewu
description:
ቸር አገልጋይ ማነው ለንጉሥ የታመነ

በመውጣት በመውረድ አትርፎ መጥቶ ነው 
በጥቂቱ ታምኖ በብዙ የተሾመው 
ባለ አምስቱ መክሊት ሊቀ ጳጳሱ ነው 

++++++++++++++++++++

ሳይሰለች የተጋ ባለሁለት መክሊት 
የታመነ እረኛ በፍቅርና በእምነት
ግባ የተባለው ወደ ጌታው ደስታ 
አጥምቆ ያቆርባል ካህኑ የጌታ 

++++++++++++++++++++

ለሚበልጠው ጸጋ ተጠርቶ የነበረ 
መክሊቱን ደብቆ ቆፍሮ የቀበረ
ሰነፍ ባርያ ተብሎ ወደ ፍርድ ተጣለ 
ማኔ ቴቄል ፋሬስ በአምላክ ፊት ቀለለ 

++++++++++++++++++++

ፈቃድህን ማድረግ ነፍሱ ለምትወደው 
ወንጌልህን መግለፅ የየዕለት ግብሩ ነው 
ህግህ ለዘለላም ተጽፎ ይኖራል 
በታላቅ ጉባኤ ጽድቅህ ይነገራል

                        መዝሙር
              ዲያቆን ቀዳሜጸጋ ዮሐንስ

The mezmur is sung by the talented Zemarit Biruktawit Gebremedhin, shares a powerful message about the word of god. Zemarit Biruktawit is widely known as one of the most beloved singers of Tigrinya Orthodox mezmur.

This Tigrinya Orthodox mezmur is offered as praise and worship to our lord. May the holy spirit touch your heart and strengthen your faith.

description: This mezmur honors the holy archangels and their role in God’s divine plan as protectors, messengers, and servants of salvation. title: The Stars
description: This mezmur honors the saints and martyrs of the Orthodox faith, portraying them as shining stars who illuminate the darkness of the world. It recounts the lives and sacrifices of figures such as Saint Stephen, Saint Arsema, Saint George, and the modern martyrs, emphasizing their courage, purity, and unwavering faith in Christ. The chant inspires believers to follow their example, remain steadfast during trials, and uphold the faith with strength and devotion.

description: This mezmur is a deeply emotional call from God to the human soul, asking why it has drifted away. It reflects God's love and sorrow as He calls His beloved back from the darkness and dangers of the world. It emphasizes God's desire for relationship, questioning what caused the distance, and inviting repentance and return. Overall, it portrays a powerful dialogue of divine love, human struggle, and the call to come back to God.

title: By the Lord's grand design
description: This mezmur reflects the divine order and sovereignty of God over all creation. It emphasizes that everything in existence is part of God’s perfect plan and design, both in heaven and on earth. The chant reassures believers that in every season—joy or sorrow—God is guiding all things for good for those who love Him. It highlights trust in God’s will, the beauty of creation, and the peace found in relying on His perfect purpose.

title: To Him Who Sits on the Throne
title_english: To Him Who Sits on the Throne
description: This mezmur is a song of worship to Jesus Christ, the Lamb who was slain and now sits on the throne in glory. Drawing from the imagery of Revelation, it proclaims praise from all creation—angels, elders, and the righteous—honoring Him as King of kings. It reflects on His humility, sacrifice on the Cross, and ultimate victory, calling all to bow and glorify His name. The chant also looks forward to the promise of eternal life, renewal, and the heavenly kingdom prepared for believers.

To Him who sits on the throne
The Lamb who is Slain to atone
Praise and Honor, Glory and power
Amen amen amen forever and ever

Let every creature in heaven and on earth
With thousands of angels and twenty-four elders
With the righteous and the four living beings
Praise the Conqueror and the King of kings/x2/

He became a man and, didn’t think it a loss
He was obedient up to death on the Cross
Let every knee bow, let every tongue praise
To Jesus Christ the name above all names/x2/

Because the wedding of the divine Lamb has come
Let's wash and clean our robes by the blood of the groom
And sing like the roar of rushing waters
Like a mighty wave, as loud peals of thunder/x2/

He who sits on the throne will make everything new
He will wipe every tear, His words are always true
He prepared for us a place no eyes have seen
And no ears have heard, for that let us all sing/x2/

title: Qana Zegelila
description:
Original song: Qana ZeGelila
Original Singer: Kesis Mindaye Birhanu


Cana of Galilee (2) in the matrimony
Virgin we have found you with divinity 
Our Lord we have found you with our Lady

Invited were the crowds flooding through the foyer
Celebrating they ate emptied the wine chamber 
Our Holy Virgin the Mother of our Lord 
For your mediation it is you they implored

With you in attendance ashamed they will not feel
Nothing is beneath you fill with wine their barrel
“They have no wine” you said to your son our Lord 
It is our Mother we cherish and adore 

Divinity of Lord that was unveiled to us
How fortunate it was the house of Dokimas 
And today in the home of this grand unity 
Blessings have spilled to us, with His humility 

Transfigured was the wine when it was just water 
In Cana Galilee our eyes did not falter 
If we ensure that He remains within our midst
Good wine will overflow as written in the scripts

title: Medhane Alem Yelem Yemisanew
title_english: O My Savior I Can Do All Through You
description:
O My Savior, I can do all through You
Emmanuel, I can do all through You
Only declare the word, and mountains will be moved
O My Savior, I can do all through You

I never thought I could pass this adversity
My bed was drenched with tears, as they rolled down my cheeks 
His strength is made perfect, in the face of weakness 
I passed through rough waters,  my burden became less

He’s the crown of my home, Advisor to my plans
The teacher of my soul, through the good and the bad
He didn’t forget me, in the day of my need 
He wiped my tears away, and filled my home with glee


Yesterday I was poor, I had nothing to claim 
I had not one title, and nothing to my name
But I’m made whole today, only by His mercy, 
Glory be to my God, He who never leaves me


He removes from my path, that which is not for me, 
And by His Will He gives, that which does profit me
All things were made by Him, and without Him was naught
Glory and Praise be to, our King Jesus Christ

title: You're The Soul For My Soul English Orthodox Tewahedo Hymn
title_english: You’re the Soul for My Soul
description:
Original Singer : Zemari Kesis Mindaye Berhanu
Original Song : Lenefese nefeswa nesh 

Mezmur translator:- Zemarit Gellila Yohannes

Lenefese nefeswa nesh, Lemengede fana
Endaltefa amnalew, Yanchi lij Negna

You’re the soul for my soul, and the Light of my path
I know I won’t perish i’m a child of Yours

Mothers of the righteous, in number they’re many
Before and after Christ, truly they are plenty
But Mary You are one, there is no one like You
You live on for ages, guiding us all to You

All those who call on you, all who honor your name
All who offer praises, your glory who proclaims
Truly he does profit, and truly does he gain
There is none who loses, there is none put to shame

Saint Gregory and the, righteous father St John
St Basil who is Great, and St. Athanasius 
Our teacher St. Ephrem and St George our father
All profited from you, calling you their Mother

Go and ask your Fathers, is what the Word proclaims
And when we did ask them, all of the righteous saints 
They did tell us of You, how you endlessly love
How you plead for mankind, saving us from above 

Gabriel from heaven, Elizabeth from Earth
Together they did preach, honor to Virgin birth 
Whoever pleads to You, calling upon Your name
He can only profit, no one is put to shame

title: Nation of The Cross
description: This mezmur proclaims the identity of believers as the people of the Cross, whose true home is in heaven. It emphasizes voluntary faith in Christ, a life rooted in forgiveness, and readiness to endure suffering for His sake. Drawing from scripture, it highlights courage in the face of persecution, trust in God's ultimate authority, and the victory of Christ over the world. The chant also honors martyrdom, affirming that those who sacrifice for their faith will be rewarded in God's eternal kingdom.

title: Selam Leki
description: This mezmur is a hymn of veneration to the Virgin Mary, greeting her with titles drawn from the Old Testament and sacred tradition. She is symbolically identified with holy objects and events such as Noah’s Ark, Aaron’s rod, Gideon’s fleece, Jacob’s ladder, and the manna of heaven—each pointing to her role in bearing Christ. The chant emphasizes her purity, divine selection, and her place as the Mother of God (Eme Egziabher). Through poetic praise, the faithful honor her as the fulfillment of biblical types and approach her with reverence, asking for her blessings and intercession.

ያንን ሰው ባ’ረገኝ  ፣ ያቺንም ሴት በሆንኩ

ምነው እሱን በሆንኩ 
ያን የቀኝ ወንበዴ 
ብመስለው ላ’ንድቀን : ባየው መንገዴ 

ለመስረቅ አይደለም ንብረት ለመቀማት
አልያም ለመዝረፍ ሕይወትን ለማጥፋት 

በዚያ መንገድማ 

ከሱስ ብበልጥ እንጂ መች ከእርሱ አንስና 
እኔን ታውቀኝ የለ …  
የወንበዴ አለቃ ያ’ጢኣተኞች ዋና 

ያ … ጸጸት ያዘለ 
በዚያች የጭንቅ ሠዓት «አስበኝ» እያለ
ከመስቀልህ ጥላ ከሥር ስለዋለ 
ካ’ዳም ቀድሞ ገባ ምሕረት ተቀበለ 

እኔም እንደ ጥጦስ : ማታዬ እንዲያምር 
ብትለኝ ምን አለ? … 
«ከገነት ተጠለል: ዛሬን ከእኔ እደር»


🍁 ላንዴ እስከወዲያኛው 
ያንን ሰው ባ’ረገኝ  ፣ ያቺንም ሴት በሆንኩ

ለንጊኖስን በሆንኩ

description:
#የመዝሙሩ ግጥም 


ታትመሻል

ታትመሻል በሰው ልቦና
የደካሞች ምርኩዝ ነሽና 
ላመስግንሽ በአዲስ ዝማሬ
እመቤቴ ገና ነው ፍቅሬ

የተፅናናንብሽ የድሆች ማረፊያ
ነፋስ ውቅያኖሱን ወጀቡን መቅዘፊያ
ወርሰናል ስምሽን ከወርቁ መዝገብ ላይ
ወለድሽልን  ድንግል የሕይወትን ፀሐይ 

ፅዮን ብለናል ነሽ መማፀኛችን
ሞትን አናይም ካለሽ እናታችን /2/

ቀስተ ደመናዬ ሁነሽ ምልክቴ
አለሁ እስከዛሬ ባንቺው በእመቤቴ
ልጅሽን አምኜ ምን ይጎልብኛል 
ያስጨነቀኝ ሁሉ ይታዘዝልኛል

ተከቧል ተራራው በብሩህ ደመና
የአብ ልጅ ክርስቶስ ባንቺ ወርዷልና 
ይባቤ ምስጋና አፋችን ይመላ
መቅደስ አላየሁም ድንግል ካንቺ ሌላ

የከሳሼን ጉልበት ፅናቱን ሰብረሻል 
የአዳም ልጅ ከሲኦል ከሞት ወጥቶብሻል
ጣፈጣት  ለነፍሴ የማህጸንሽ ፍሬ 
ስጠራሽ እኖራለሁ በያሬድ ዝማሬ

title: I have no righteous deeds
description: This mezmur is a humble prayer of repentance and supplication to the Holy Virgin Mary. It expresses the believer’s recognition of sin and unworthiness, while seeking her intercession for mercy and forgiveness. The chant highlights Mary as a source of strength, comfort, and spiritual healing, emphasizing her role as the Mother of God who pleads on behalf of humanity. It reflects deep humility, repentance, and reliance on her compassion.

title: Qidus Gebriel

ዘማ……………… 
በባቢሎን አገር ያሉ ሦስት ሕጻናት 
ለፈጣሪያቸው የታመኑ በእውነት 
ለአገሩ ጣኦት አንሰግድም ስላሉ

ዘማ…………… 
ቂርቆስ ኢየሉጣ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኑ 
ስለስሙ ኖረው ምስክር ሊሆኑ 
በፈጣሪያቸው በመታመናቸው

            በሰማዕትነት እስክታርፍ ነፍሳቸው 
            ቅዱስ ገብርኤል ነው ወርዶ ያበረታቸው 
ዘማ…………

title: Iruq Newu
description:
እሩቅ ነው ልቤ ከልብህ
መንገዴ አይደለም መንገድህ
የሽንገላ ነው መውደዴ
ጌታዬ የምልህ ውዴ

ለታይታ ነው የኔ ጌታ ያንተ ሆኜ እኮ አላውቅም

ብዙ ስትዳክር ነፍሴ እረፍቷን ከሰው ፈልጋ
ግን አላወቀችውም ሰላሟ እንዳለ አንተ ጋ

እርዳኝ አልል በችግሬ
እኔ አላከብርህ ጌታዬ 
በሸክላው ነው የምመካው
ወድቆ በሚሰበረው/2/

አማኝ ነኝ ለሚያየኝ ተቆርቋሪ ለህግህ
በጽድቅህ የምጓዝ የምመራ በመንፈስህ
ግን ሌላ ነኝ በአንተ ፊት የሌለኝ ፍጹም ፍቅር
ምህረትህ ጋርዳኝ እንጂ ማይገባኝ ነኝ መኖር

አሰማምሬ ምናገር
በዓለም ፊት ያንተን ነገር
ነፍሴን ያጎደልኩኝ ምስኪን 
ንካው ለውጠው ልቤን/2/

እሩቅ ነኝ ለመልካም እሩቅ ነኝ ለይቅርታ 
የምደሰት በዓለም በበደል በኃጢአት ትዝታ 
ያለህ እስከማይመስለኝ ቤትህን የምዳፈር
አባትነትህ ራርቶልኝ ያላነሳህብኝ በትር

የማልወድ ነኝ ወንድሜን
ከአጠገቤ ያለውን
ታድያ እንዴት ነው ማስደስትህ
ሳላከብር ያንተን ትዕዛዝ

መዝሙሬ እንኳን ለራሴ ነው ክብርና ስሜን ፍለጋ
በሰዎች መወደድን አድርጌው ማትረፊያ ዋጋ
መች አፈርኩህ እንደ አባቶቼ መች ዝቅ አልኩኝ በትህትና 
ክርስቲያን ለመባልማ እኔ ገና ነኝ ገና

ነጠላዬን አስውቤው
ውስጤን በትዕቢት ሞልቼው
ብዘምር በአደባባይ 
አወይ እኔ አተርፍ ባይ

It also calls the faithful to venerate her and seek her intercession, recognizing her role in uniting humanity with Christ.

title_english: You Triumph the Works of Evil
description:
Original Song: Hayal Neh Ante
Singer: Liqe Mezemeran Tewodros Yosef

You triumph the works of evil
The mighty angel St. Gebriel
Let the enemy surrender 
Be my rescuing defender

ኃያል ነህ አንተ ኃያል
ደጉ መልአክ ገብርኤል
ይውደቅ ይሸነፍ ጠላት
አንተ ተራዳን በውነት

On the field of Dura 
An idol was arranged 
To favor its worship
A law had been proclaimed
But the wise children had remained faithful and true
They turned to The Most High temptations they subdued 

Frustrated was the king
With the youthful children 
In fire to be burned
He ordered to throw them
Descended down from the heavens as he was sent 
Untouched by the fire he saved them from torment 

They were filled with praises
Beneath the fire pit
The ones that pushed them in
Found themselves within it
They persevered with joy aided by Almighty
The nobles of the king witnessed the Lord’s glory 

Nebuchadnezzar was
Bemused by what he saw
The mighty arch angel
Snatched them out of his claw 
He praised the Lord who sent the angel to save them
He kneeled before their God for worship unto Him

title: I called unto my Dear Lord
title_english: I called unto my Dear Lord
description: This mezmur is a heartfelt prayer of calling upon God in times of distress and weakness. It expresses trust in God’s mercy, His readiness to hear prayers, and His power to rescue from sin, fear, and despair. The chant reflects repentance, dependence on God, and confidence in His protection, drawing parallels to biblical deliverance like Noah’s salvation. It emphasizes faith, repentance, and unwavering trust in God’s saving power.

I called unto my Dear Lord when my life was impaired
I called unto my Father when I had none to spare
My anxiousness he calmed rescued me from despair

When I appeal to Him He hears my desperate cry
His ears are attentive and open are His eyes
For He will rescue me from a life that is grim
I may be unworthy but still I will praise Him

Unable to walk on the path of righteousness
The drowning waves of sin seemed to me tireless
When I appealed to Him with a regretful heart
He brought forth His mercy and pulled me from the dark

Just as you saved Noah rescue us from the storm
Shield us from the arrows coming in every form
My strength will be in you I won’t tremble in fear
I will lean on the cross knowing my God is near

With abundant mercy death was left in the past
He never left His child showing His love is vast
God received me with joy with His bright shining light
Who will stand against me with my Lord as my might

title: Before the most high
description: This mezmur expresses a life centered on worship, humility, and devotion to God. It speaks about entering the house of God with reverence, offering praise, repentance, and thanksgiving. The chant reflects the example of King David in worship, the importance of the church as a dwelling place of God, and the believer’s desire to live righteously, give offerings, and seek salvation. It emphasizes praise, sacrifice, and a continual relationship with God through prayer and worship.

title: I call out your name
description: This mezmur is a deep expression of faith and reliance on the intercession of the Holy Virgin Mary. To receive the Lord's love what have I done for Him?
Although it's not enough I'm offering this hymn
Your strength lifted me up aided my weakness then
You fixed this broken bridge so I can cross again

Although it's not enough I'm offering this hymn
Your strength lifted me up aided my weakness then
You fixed this broken bridge so I can cross again

When I had nothing left begging in Jericho
Swallowed up by darkness I had nowhere to go
The Lord of light had heard my cries and He drew near
With His hands healed me, my vision became clear

To receive the Lord's love what have I done for Him?
Although it's not enough I'm offering this hymn
Your strength lifted me up aided my weakness then
You fixed this broken bridge so I can cross again

For many months and years I had been bedridden
No one came to my aid no support was given
My Lord and my Savior He came to me and said
Your sins are forgiven rise and carry and your bed

To receive the Lord's love what have I done for Him?
Although it's not enough I'm offering this hymn
Your strength lifted me up aided my weakness then
You fixed this broken bridge so I can cross again

With twelve long years of pain blood flowing with no end
I was rejected with no one to call a friend
When Christ came near I touched the edge of His clothing
The power that came forth ended my suffering

To receive the Lord's love what have I done for Him?
Although it's not enough I'm offering this hymn
Your strength lifted me up aided my weakness then
You fixed this broken bridge so I can cross again

I was a drunk, a thief and an adulterer
I was the cheif rebel and was a murderer
But I praise God because He changed my life around
In His power and hope today I do abound

To receive the Lord's love what have I done for Him?
Although it's not enough I'm offering this hymn
Your strength lifted me up aided my weakness then
You fixed this broken bridge so I can cross again

title: The Purest of the Pure
description: This mezmur praises the Virgin Mary as the purest and holiest among all creation. It highlights her role as the Mother of God, the sealed fountain, and the chosen vessel through whom Christ came into the world. The chant reflects on her humility, purity, and exalted position in heaven, honored by angels and saints alike. It also emphasizes her role as an intercessor for humanity, calling believers to seek her prayers and recognize her as the spiritual mother given to redeem what was lost through Eve.

👇👇👇👇👇👇👇👇👇👇👇👇👇👇👇👇👇👇👇💚💛💓👇👇

ይችን ዓመት ተወኝ 
ከዓመት እስከአመት ፍሬን ሳላፈራ ደረቅ እንደሆንኩኞ

በራድ ወይም ትኩስ ሁለቱንም ሳልሆን እንዲያው ለብ እንዳልኩኝ ፤
አለሁኝ በቤትህ ለሙን መሬትህን እያጎሳቆልኩኝ ፤

አውቃለሁ አምላኬ ፍሬየን ለመልቀም እንዳመላለስኩህ ፤
ዛሬም ሳላፈራ እሾህን አብቅየ  ደርቄ ጠበኩህ  ፤

ያልተደረገልኝ ያላፈሰስክብኝ ያልሰጠኸኝ የለም ፤
ነገር ግን ይህ ሁሉ አላርምህ አለኝ አልለየኝም ከአለም ።
የማትሰለቸኝ ሆይ ተነስቼ እስክቆም እባክህ ታገሰኝ ፤
የኔን ክፋት ተወዉ መልአክህን ሰምተህ ይችን ዓመት ተወኝ ። 

  አውቃለሁ ታውቃለህ ቀጠሮን ሰጥቼ እንደማላከብር፤
ብዙ ግዜ አቅጄ ብዙ ጊዜ ዝቼ በወሬ እንደምቀር ።

ዘንድሮስ እንዳልኩኝ አምና ይኸ  ጊዜ ሰምተኸኝ ነበረ፤
ምንም ሳልለወጥ ዘንድሮየ አልፎ ባዲስ ተቀየረ  ።

ፍሬ የማይወጣኝ እኔን በመኮትኮት እጆችህ ደከሙ ፤
እኔ ግን አለሁኝ ዛሬም አልበቃኝም በኃጢአት መታመሙ ።

የቃልህን ውሐ በድንጋይ ልጅህ ላይ  ሳትታክት ስታፈስ ዘመን ተቆጠረ ፤
ወደልቤ ሳይሰርግ ህይወቴን ሳይለውጥ እንዲያው ፈስሶ ቀረ ።

ቃልህን ጠግቤ እያገሳሁት ነው ሌሎች እስኪሰሙ ፤
በቃልህ መኖር ግን አልያዝህ አለኝ ከበደኝ ቀለሙ ።

ብዙ ጥቅስ አገኝሁ  ከቅዱስ መጽሐፍህ ገልጬ አይቼ ፤
ከራሴ ላይ ብቻ አንድ ጥቅስ አጣሁንኝ  በበደል ተኝቼ  ።
ውጤቴ ደካማ ትምህርት የማይሰርጸኝ  ተማሪ ብሆንም ፤
ይችን ዓመት ተወኝ ተደግሞ ትንሽ ልማር ታገሰኝ አሁንም  ።

እባክህ አልቆረጥ በቅዱስ መሬትህ  ልቆይ ፍቀድልኝ ፤
ያፈሩት ቅዱሳን የፍሬያቸው ሽታ መአዛ እንዲደርሰኝ ።

የተሸከምከኝ ሆይ ዛሬም ተሸከመኝ አትሰልቸኝ አደራ ፤
ማን ይታገሰኛል ጠላት እየሆንኩት   እየሰሩ ስሰራ ።

አታውጣኝ ከቤትህ ብዙ ቦታ አልይዝም ፍሬ ስለሌለኝ
ስፍራ የማያሻኝ  ቤት የማላጣብብ ፍሬ አልባ በለስ ነኝ ።

ቦታ የሚይዙት ባለምግባሮቹ ቅዱሳንህ ናቸው ፤
ልክ እንደዘንባባ የተንዠረገገ ተጋድሎ ጽድቃቸው ።
ከሊባኖስ ዝግባ  እጅጉን የበዛ  ገድል ትሩፋታቸው ፤

እኔ አይደለሁም ቦታስ የምትይዘው የአንተው እናት ናት ፤
ስሮቿ በምድር  ጫፎቿ በሰማይ ሲደርሱ ያየናት  ፤
ይችን አመት ተወኝ  ከስሯ እሆናለሁ ባፈራ ምናልባት ፤

ይቺን ዓመት ተወኝ እባክህ አምላኬ አንድ ዓመት ምንህ ናት ፤
ሺህ ዓመት አንድ ቀን አይደለም ወይ ላንተ ዓመት ኢምንትህ ናት ።

ይኸ ዓመት አልፎ ደግሞ ዓመት ስጠኝ እስከምልህ ድረስ  ፤
እባክህ ጌታየ ይችን ዓመት ተወኝ  የወጉን እንዳደርስ ።
         (ዲያቆን  ሔኖክ ኃይሌ )

✝️የጽዮን ደጆች✝️

የጽዮን ደጆች ቅኔን ተሞሉ

 የዜማ እቃችንን አነሳን ልጆችሽ

አፋችን ማርያም ሲል ጭንቃችን ቀለለ

የጽዮን ደጆች ቅኔን ተሞሉ

አርፈናል ስሟን ስንጠራ(2)


የምስጋና ጥበብ የቅኔ ሃብት ፀጋ

 ፅዮንን በእልልታ በዜማ ሸፍነን

አማላጄ አንቺን ይዥለሁ
አዛኝቱ  አንቺን ይዥለሁ

ዙርያዬን ሲጨልም ብርሃን ሆንሽኝ

ቀና ቀና ያልኩት በምልጃሽ ነው(2)

አማላጄ አንቺን ይዥለሁ
አዛኝቱ አንቺን ይዥለሁ

ከልጅነት አንደበቴ

It recounts the ظلم, mockery, and pain He endured, while emphasizing His unwavering mercy and forgiveness toward humanity. It calls the faithful to remember His love and remain steadfast in worship.

እየተፈጸመ ፣ ኃይሉ በድካሜ

የቤቴ ራስ ነው ፣ የእቅዴ መሪ

ፈጥሮ የማይረሳኝ ፣ ቤዛዬ ደረሰ 
ቤቴን ደስታ ሞላው ፣ ዕንባዬ ታበሰ።

ትናንት ባዶ ነበርኩ ፣ የለኝ የሚሰፈር
አንዳች አልነበረኝ ፣ የሚታይ የሚቆጠር
ከእርሱ የተነሳ ፣ ዛሬ ግን ሙሉ ነኝ
ክብር ለእርሱ ይሁን ፣ አለ የማይተወኝ።

እየከለከለ ፣ ለእኔ ማይጠቅመኝን
በጊዜ እየሰጠ ፣ ደግሞ ሚረባኝን
ሁሉ በእርሱ ሆኗል ፣ አልሆነም ያለ እርሱ 
ውዳሴ ምስጋና ፣ ይድረስ ለንጉሡ ።
